name: SIRUI
source: https://s2.sirui.com/upload/manual/2022/1008/dYrs3Y4RR3.pdf (official SIRUI 1.25x Anamorphic Adapter user manual, page 2; Adobe Illustrator 25.2 PDF hosted on SIRUI's own CDN and linked from https://www.siruiusa.com/index/index/instructionmanuals.html). The identical vector wordmark also appears in https://s2.sirui.com/upload/manual/2025/1031/MDKBsAAsat.pdf (24mm T1.2 cine lens manual).
license: Public domain in the US as a simple text logo (PD-textlogo per Wikimedia Commons determination for the same SIRUI logo, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Logo_of_SIRUI_Optical.png; raster only, used for licence status, not traced); vector paths taken from the brand's official PDF manual (no explicit licence; trademark)
trademark: Guangdong SIRUI Optical Co., Ltd. (SIRUI) - nominative use only
notes: No SIRUI entry in Simple Icons and no SVG on Wikimedia Commons (only the PNG cited above). The official websites (sirui.com Shopify store, cn.sirui.com, cf.sirui.com, siruiusa.com) serve raster logos only, so the vector came from an official SIRUI manual PDF. Extracted the five blue (CMYK approx. #074DA2) SIRUI letter paths with PyMuPDF get_svg_image. They are real vector paths, not text. Dropped the square emblem to the left of the wordmark (grey border, blue square, white lens mark and small white SIRUI). Each letter carried matrix(1,0,0,-1,tx,ty) (the PDF y-flip); baked into absolute coordinates with svgpath, shifted to the origin and rounded to 0.001. Only the R has a counter (a second subpath with opposite winding), so nonzero renders it open. The R foot serif (right edge x=57.986, bottom) and the U top-left serif (left edge x=57.987, top) share the same x but sit at different heights, so the letters interlock without touching, as in the original artwork. Horizontal slab-serif wordmark. Verified: pixel IoU 0.97-0.98 against the official PDF rendered at 10x (differences are edge antialiasing only); Commons file page carries {{PD-textlogo}}{{Trademark}}.
